name: Glowing Gem
summary: At Lake Falathim, the Glowing Gem lies among the murlocs after Teronis fell seeking it. The stone holds magic needed to restore Dartol's rod.

sections.title: A Lost Relic of Dartol
sections.body: Murlocs near Lake Falathim hold the Glowing Gem, a stone with latent magic. Teronis, a young night elf from Astranaar, went after it to find a way to push back the corruption spreading through Ashenvale's forests. Teronis died at the lake, but the stone remained intact among the scavengers along the shore.

sections.title: Restoring the Rod
sections.body: After the Glowing Gem and Teronis's journal are recovered, Sentinel leader Raene Wolfrunner sends the bearer northeast to Shael'dryn, a dryad keeping watch at a nearby moonwell. Shael'dryn knows how to bind the gem to the other missing pieces of Dartol's rod, carrying Teronis's work forward.

faq.q: Where does the Glowing Gem come from?
faq.answer: Murlocs carry the Glowing Gem along the shores and shallow waters around the shrine at Lake Falathim in western Ashenvale, where Teronis fell.

faq.q: Why was Teronis looking for this gem?
faq.answer: Teronis sought a way to cleanse the growing foulness in Ashenvale. His research named the Glowing Gem as a key part needed to rebuild a magical rod devised by Dartol.

faq.q: Who should I take the Glowing Gem to?
faq.answer: Show the Glowing Gem and Teronis's journal to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar, then take the stone northeast to Shael'dryn, the dryad at the moonwell east of Iris Lake.

faq.q: What is the rod of Dartol?
faq.answer: Dartol's rod is a magical instrument he created. Its pieces were scattered across the forest, and the Glowing Gem is needed to rebuild it.

angles.text: As a night elf, recovering the gem and carrying out Teronis's mission honors the fallen scout and helps the Sentinels protect Ashenvale from spreading corruption.
As a druid, Teronis's research into the spreading corruption and the relic he hoped to restore concern you.
